summary: DeepSeek added a web search API for agents, a compact open multimodal model trended, and installs of the MCP software kits kept growing.

picks.title: DeepSeek adds search and page-fetch APIs for AI agents
picks.note: DeepSeek published two web APIs: one returns search results from its own search engine, the other turns a web page into Markdown text. They are meant for agents and apps that need live web content. The docs say failed, empty or timed-out requests are not charged. The announcement drew 566 points on Hacker News.

picks.title: MiniCPM-V 4.7, a compact open multimodal model, is trending
picks.note: OpenBMB's MiniCPM-V 4.7 is an open model that reads images and video. It has 35 billion parameters in total; the 'A3B' in its name means about 3 billion are active for each token (a mixture-of-experts design), which keeps it light enough to run on phones. It is released under the Apache-2.0 license and ranks #2 on Hugging Face trending.

picks.title: Installs of the MCP software kits rise
picks.signal: MCP TypeScript SDK +28%, MCP Python SDK +14%
picks.note: MCP (Model Context Protocol) is a standard way for AI apps to connect to outside tools and data. Installs of the TypeScript SDK grew 28% and the Python SDK 14%, level with FastMCP at 14%. The TypeScript SDK shipped 1.32.0 on 2 October, which limits when its HTTP client follows redirects.
